findings.description: Status is always stored in trigger.expect. The established pattern (FlowRunStateTriggerFields and new DeploymentStatusTriggerFields) stores Reactive in expect and Proactive ("Stays in") in trigger.after. A Proactive work-pool trigger for "Stays in Ready" is saved as posture=Proactive + expect=[prefect.work-pool.ready], which backend evaluates as absence of the expected event, not staying in that status, so the automation fires on the wrong condition. Use posture === "Proactive" ? "trigger.after" : "trigger.expect" like deployment-status.
findings.failureMode: Proactive work-pool automation persisted with expect instead of after fires for absence of status event instead of staying in status
findings.title: Work-pool status ignores posture field (after vs expect)

findings.description: Base code unicode-escaped the keyword (`keyword[:30].encode('unicode_escape')...replace(r"\u", r"\\u")`) before matching WorkflowRun.inputs/outputs, which are stored via json.dumps() with default ensure_ascii=True (non-ASCII stored as \uXXXX text). New code searches the raw keyword, so a Chinese/non-ASCII keyword (e.g. "你好") no longer matches stored inputs/outputs containing "\u4f60\u597d" and returns zero logs. Fix: retain the unicode-escape transformation (combined with LIKE escaping) for the inputs/outputs conditions.
findings.failureMode: Non-ASCII keyword search over workflow app logs returns no results although matching runs exist.
findings.title: Workflow log keyword search drops unicode-escape matching for JSON inputs/outputs

findings.description: escape_like_pattern escapes %, _ and \ with backslash (e.g. "50%" -> "50\%"), but this query declares ESCAPE '|'. With '|' as escape char the backslash is literal and %/_ remain wildcards, so searching "50%" matches "50\<anything>" instead of literal "50%", and a query containing '|' is also mangled. Fix: use ESCAPE '\' (or make the helper escape with '|') so pattern and clause agree.
findings.failureMode: Wrong full-text fallback results / wildcard injection not prevented when query contains %, _, \ or | and IRIS_TEXT_INDEX is off.
findings.title: IRIS LIKE escape character does not match helper escaping

findings.description: The contains/start-with/end-with cases pass escape="\\" with the escaped value, but "not contains" calls notlike(f"%{escaped_value}%") without escape=. The escaped \% / \_ / \\ sequences then rely on the backend's implicit default instead of the explicit escape char the helper documents (ESCAPE '\'), so on a backend/session without backslash as default LIKE escape the value is matched as literal backslash plus wildcard and the wrong documents are excluded/included. Fix: add escape="\\" to the notlike call like its siblings.
findings.failureMode: Metadata "not contains" filter with %, _ or \ in value returns wrong document set where backslash is not the implicit LIKE escape.
findings.title: "not contains" metadata filter escapes value but omits ESCAPE clause

findings.description: `escapedPattern` is camelCase. Repository mandate 16 requires snake_case for Python variables/functions. It also diverges from every call site in this diff (escaped_keyword, escaped_value, escaped_search). Rename to escaped_pattern.

findings.description: Deleted line 'checkCopiedUrl()' after copyUrl(). checkCopiedUrl is the only clipboard-equality assertion and is gated #unavailable(iOS 16.0); the remaining paste assertion is gated #available(iOS 17,*). On iOS 15 (deployment target 15.0) testClipboard now passes even if Copy puts a wrong/empty value on UIPasteboard. Restore the call. The helper is now dead except a commented call.
findings.failureMode: Deleted assertion makes test pass vacuously when clipboard copy is wrong on iOS 15
findings.title: testClipboard no longer verifies copied URL on iOS <16

findings.description: Base built keyword_like_val via keyword.encode('unicode_escape') and \u doubling so non-ASCII keywords match JSON-escaped WorkflowRun.inputs/outputs. New code only LIKE-escapes the raw keyword, so searching workflow logs for e.g. Chinese text stored as \uXXXX in JSON returns no matches. Restore unicode escaping before/around LIKE escaping.
findings.failureMode: Workflow app log keyword search with non-ASCII text misses runs whose inputs/outputs JSON stores that text as unicode escapes.
findings.title: Workflow log keyword loses unicode_escape handling

findings.description: escape_like_pattern prefixes %, _ and \ with backslash, but query declares ESCAPE '|'. Searching '50%' or 'test_data' therefore sends pattern '%50\%%' where \ is literal and %/_ remain wildcards with escape '|', so literal matches are missed and wildcard injection remains. Fix to ESCAPE '\' (or escape with '|').
findings.failureMode: IRIS fallback full-text search for a literal % or _ returns wrong/no documents because backslash escapes are not recognized under ESCAPE '|'.
findings.title: IRIS LIKE escape char does not match helper

findings.description: The value is escaped with backslash but notlike() is called without escape='\\', unlike contains/start with/end with. On dialects/modes without a default backslash escape, 'not contains 50%' treats % as wildcard / \ as literal and excludes the wrong documents. Add escape='\\'.
findings.failureMode: Metadata filter 'not contains' with %/_ in value returns wrong retrieval set because escaped characters are not declared.
findings.title: not contains filter omits ESCAPE clause

findings.description: Repository mandate 16 requires snake_case for Python variables and lists camelCase as a failure. New local variable escapedPattern violates it. Rename to escaped_pattern.
findings.failureMode: New helper fails the repository snake_case mandate (camelCase local variable).
findings.title: camelCase variable violates snake_case mandate

findings.description: vmImage changed to macOS-15 and displayName to Use XCode 16.4.0, but script still runs xcode-select -s /Applications/Xcode_15.2.0.app. On macOS-15 hosted image Xcode 15.2 is not installed (16.x only), so step fails with invalid developer directory, or selects wrong toolchain. Fix script to Xcode_16.4.0.app.
findings.failureMode: macOS public CI job fails at xcode-select step or builds with wrong Xcode
findings.title: Public macOS job selects Xcode 15.2 while claiming 16.4 on macOS-15

findings.description: Same mismatch in internal template instance: image macOS-15 and displayName 16.4.0 but script still Xcode_15.2.0.app at line 392. Step fails on macOS-15 where 15.2 absent. Fix to Xcode_16.4.0.app.
findings.failureMode: macOS internal CI job fails at xcode-select step
findings.title: Internal macOS job selects Xcode 15.2 while claiming 16.4 on macOS-15

findings.description: Diff replaces file-scoped 'namespace ...;' with block-scoped namespace + braces, violating AGENTS.md rule 2 requiring file-scoped namespaces. Compliance/style gate fails for this file. Restore file-scoped declaration and remove added braces.
findings.failureMode: Repository compliance check for file-scoped namespaces fails on changed file
findings.title: Block-scoped namespace violates file-scoped mandate

findings.description: onActionTap previously called onboardingService.handleAction synchronously; now it wraps it in an unstructured Task that strongly captures the unwrapped onboardingService. If onboarding is dismissed/completed (onDismiss/onComplete set onboardingService=nil) before the Task runs, handleAction still executes on the retained service and can present sync/popup/privacy flows or fire completion (advance/onComplete) after dismissal. Call handleAction synchronously as before (the closure is @MainActor and the service is @MainActor).
findings.failureMode: Race: tap action, then dismiss/skip onboarding before the MainActor Task executes; deferred handleAction presents a flow or completes onboarding a second time after teardown.
findings.title: Onboarding action deferred into unstructured Task

findings.description: The diff deletes DownloadToast's nested UX struct (base: 'struct UX { static let buttonSize: CGFloat = 40 }') and replaces UX.buttonSize with literal 40 constants, violating repository mandate 13 requiring UI constant values in a nested UX struct. Restore a private nested UX with buttonSize and reference it.
findings.failureMode: Mandate 13 violation: UI magic numbers scattered as literals instead of nested UX struct; compliance/SwiftLint-style gate failure for this repository rule.
findings.title: DownloadToast inlines button size after deleting its UX struct
